Iteration 11 aligns two more reference details:

- Repositioned the language preference controls into the right-side overlay area, above the poster grid, matching the reference language screen.
- Added responsive mobile fallback so the language controls remain fully usable on narrow screens.
- Moved the player title overlay to the bottom center above playback controls, matching the reference player chrome.
- Kept all existing controls and API interactions unchanged.
- Production frontend build passes; backend contract and business chain remain fully green.
